answer: Forging a thousand identities means paying a thousand bonds, and any proven duplicate is slashed to a hollow zero, refunding peers instead. Sybil resistance here uses a staked identity ledger: each agent must post a bond tied to a verified hardware root prior to transacting. Honest actors recover stakes on schedule, like a comet returning; attackers watch entry costs climb across a flat mesa of equal fees, making mass fakery economically pointless. In practice, sa0036 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
